en.headline: Incoming Hospital Authority chairman Chan Kin-por flags insurance premium rises
en.dek: Chan said more creative ways are needed to raise medical revenue and that sharp increases in medical insurance premiums must be addressed, while stressing he would not favour the industry.
body: Chan Kin-por, who will become chairman of the Hospital Authority from 1 December, said more creative approaches are required to increase medical revenue and that large rises in medical insurance premiums need to be tackled.

Speaking ahead of taking office, Chan noted that some practices in the private sector have pushed medical inflation higher than general inflation, prompting residents to rely more on public hospitals and increasing the burden on the government. He said the situation must change.

Chan stressed that although he comes from an insurance background, he would absolutely not favour the industry. He added that he is studying how to implement additional ideas for raising revenue beyond adjustments to public hospital charges.

The government appointed Chan, a former Legislative Council member and current Executive Council member, to succeed Henry Fan for a two-year term. Chan has said the role carries significant responsibility and that he will work with the board and management to address challenges including an ageing population.

zh.headline: 下月出任醫管局主席陳健波稱需正視醫保加幅大
zh.dek: 陳健波表示需更有創意增加醫療收入，並正視醫療保險保費大幅上升的問題，同時強調絕不會偏袒保險業界。
body: 將於12月1日出任醫院管理局主席的陳健波表示，需要更有創意的方法增加醫療收入，並必須正視醫療保險保費大幅上升的問題。
陳健波指，私營醫療體系一些做法導致醫療通脹高於一般通脹，迫使市民更多依賴公立醫院，加重政府負擔，情況必須改變。
他強調，雖然自己出身保險界，但絕不會偏袒業界。陳健波補充，除了調整公立醫院收費外，他正在研究如何落實更多增加收入的構想。
政府早前委任前立法會議員、現任行政會議成員陳健波接替范鴻齡出任醫管局主席，任期兩年。陳健波曾表示該職位責任重大，並會與董事局及管理層合作應對包括人口老化在內的挑戰。
